Burning Shadows

Released August 5, 2017 · 177 cards

Expanded

Burning Shadows is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on August 5, 2017. Its main set has 147 cards, plus 30 secret rares numbered beyond the set (177 in total). It includes 142 Pokémon, 32 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

47 illustrators worked on Burning Shadows. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (39), Masakazu Fukuda (9), Ken Sugimori (7), Toyste Beach (7), Kouki Saitou (6), Mitsuhiro Arita (6), Shin Nagasawa (6), Naoki Saito (5).
